text: [Radhika Gupta @iRadhikaGupta] The secret to 15-year SIP success is not finding the fund with 2% extra alpha. It's sticking with simple Dal-Chawal funds through market corrections. When portfolios turn red, retail investors panic and hit stop. Don't abandon your compounding engine in year 2.
title: Twitter Thread by Radhika Gupta (MD & CEO - Edelweiss AMC)
author: @iRadhikaGupta

text: [Monika Halan @monikahalan] If you don't build a 6-month emergency fund before starting an equity SIP, your equity mutual fund will BECOME your emergency fund. And when life strikes—a job change, a medical bill—you will be forced to redeem units at depressed valuations with exit loads.

author: @monikahalan

text: [Pattabiraman Murari @freefincal] A 15-year SIP does NOT guarantee positive returns. If your 15th year coincides with a 2008-style 40% crash, your entire compounding gets wiped out.
